flags.question: Which users have provided answers to the question with the title 'even after null check why I am getting null value in neo4j?' Limit to the top 3.
flags.cypher:
MATCH (q:Question {title: 'even after null check why I am getting null value in neo4j?'})<-[:ANSWERED]-(a:Answer)<-[:PROVIDED]-(u:User)
RETURN u.display_name AS user
LIMIT 3
details: Question asks for top-3 but TypeQL has no sort

flags.question: List the top 3 comments with a score of 3.
flags.cypher:
MATCH (c:Comment)
WHERE c.score = 3
RETURN c
ORDER BY c.score DESC
LIMIT 3
details: Question asks for top-3 but TypeQL has no sort
Cypher has final ORDER BY but TypeQL has no sort

flags.question: Identify the 3 answers with the lowest scores provided to the most viewed questions.
flags.cypher:
MATCH (q:Question)-[:ANSWERED]-(a:Answer)
WITH q, a
ORDER BY q.view_count DESC
LIMIT 1
WITH a
ORDER BY a.score ASC
LIMIT 3
RETURN a.link AS answer_link, a.title AS answer_title, a.score AS answer_score

flags.question: List the top 3 questions with the least number of answers but with at least one accepted answer.
flags.cypher:
MATCH (q:Question)-[:ANSWERED]-(a:Answer)
WHERE a.is_accepted = true
WITH q, COUNT(a) AS answer_count
WHERE q.answer_count > 0
RETURN q.title, q.link, q.answer_count
ORDER BY q.answer_count ASC
LIMIT 3
details: Cypher filters answer_count > 0 but value 0 not in TypeQL

flags.question: What are the first 5 questions tagged with 'neo4j' that have received answers from different users?
flags.cypher:
MATCH (q:Question)-[:TAGGED]->(t:Tag {name: 'neo4j'})
MATCH (a:Answer)-[:ANSWERED]->(q)
WITH q, COUNT(DISTINCT a.uuid) AS answer_count
WHERE answer_count > 0
RETURN q.title, q.link, q.creation_date
ORDER BY q.creation_date
LIMIT 5
details: Cypher uses COUNT() but TypeQL has no count
Cypher uses COUNT(DISTINCT) but TypeQL has no distinct (may be OK if groupby handles it)

flags.question: What are the 3 most recent comments on the question with the highest view count?
flags.cypher:
MATCH (q:Question)
WITH q
ORDER BY q.view_count DESC
LIMIT 1
MATCH (c:Comment)-[:COMMENTED_ON]->(q)
RETURN c
ORDER BY c.uuid DESC
LIMIT 3
details: Question asks for "most recent" but sort may not use temporal field: $uuid desc

flags.question: What are the top 3 lowest scored answers on the most viewed questions?
flags.cypher:
MATCH (q:Question)-[:ANSWERED]-(a:Answer)
WITH q, a
ORDER BY q.view_count DESC
LIMIT 3
WITH a
ORDER BY a.score ASC

RETURN a.link AS answer_link, a.score AS answer_score, a.body_markdown AS answer_body
